schema_data:
【DB_ID】 
【Schema】
# Table: businessdb.ST_HIWRCH_B, 水情预警指标
[
(STCD:CHAR, 测站编码, Primary Key, Examples: [SC000001, SC000002, SC000003]),
(HIWRTY:CHAR, 预警类型：0洪水、1干旱, Primary Key, Examples: [0, 1]),
(HIWRCH:CHAR, 预警指标：0水位、1流量、2水量, Primary Key, Examples: [0, 1, 2]),
(WRSTAATR:CHAR, 统计标志：00瞬时、01一天、10十天, Examples: [00, 01]),
(BUWR:DECIMAL, 蓝色预警阈值；单位随指标为m、m3/s或m3, Examples: [301.0, 120.0, 10368000.0]),
(YEWR:DECIMAL, 黄色预警阈值, Examples: [302.0, 160.0, 13824000.0]),
(OGWR:DECIMAL, 橙色预警阈值, Examples: [303.0, 200.0, 17280000.0]),
(RDWR:DECIMAL, 红色预警阈值, Examples: [304.0, 240.0, 20736000.0]),
(MODITIME:DATETIME, 最新修改时间，不使用 SQL Server rowversion, Examples: [2025-06-01 00:00:00])
]
# Table: businessdb.ST_STBPRP_B, 测站基本属性
[
(STCD:CHAR, 测站编码, Primary Key, Examples: [SC000001, SC000002, SC000003]),
(STNM:VARCHAR, 测站名称, Examples: [乐山市模拟水文站01, 乐山市模拟水文站02, 内江市模拟水文站01]),
(RVNM:VARCHAR, 河流名称, Examples: [岷江, 沱江, 金沙江]),
(HNNM:VARCHAR, 水系名称, Examples: [长江水系]),
(BSNM:VARCHAR, 流域名称, Examples: [长江流域]),
(LGTD:DECIMAL, 经度，度, Examples: [104.066, 104.086, 104.779]),
(LTTD:DECIMAL, 纬度，度, Examples: [30.572, 30.592, 29.339]),
(STLC:VARCHAR, 站址, Examples: [四川省成都市模拟站址（非真实位置）, 四川省自贡市模拟站址（非真实位置）, 四川省攀枝花市模拟站址（非真实位置）]),
(ADDVCD:CHAR, 行政区划代码，未知时填 NULL, Examples: [510100, 510300, 510400]),
(DTMNM:VARCHAR, 基面名称, Examples: [1985国家高程基准（模拟）]),
(DTMEL:DECIMAL, 基面高程，m, Examples: [0.0]),
(DTPR:DECIMAL, 基面修正值，m, Examples: [0.0]),
(STTP:CHAR, 测站类型代码, Examples: [ZQ]),
(FRGRD:CHAR, 报汛等级代码, Examples: [3]),
(ESSTYM:CHAR, 建站年月，YYYYMM, Examples: [202001]),
(BGFRYM:CHAR, 始报年月，YYYYMM, Examples: [202001]),
(ATCUNIT:VARCHAR, 隶属单位, Examples: [四川模拟水文单位]),
(ADMAUTH:VARCHAR, 管理单位, Examples: [成都市模拟管理单位, 自贡市模拟管理单位, 攀枝花市模拟管理单位]),
(LOCALITY:VARCHAR, 地方管理或归属信息, Examples: [四川省]),
(STBK:CHAR, 测站岸别代码, Examples: [0, 1]),
(STAZT:DECIMAL, 测站方位，度, Examples: [0.0, 45.0]),
(DSTRVM:DECIMAL, 至河口距离，km, Examples: [500.0, 510.0, 520.0]),
(DRNA:DECIMAL, 集水面积，km2, Examples: [1000.0, 1100.0, 1200.0]),
(PHCD:VARCHAR, 地形代码),
(USFL:CHAR, 使用标志, Examples: [1]),
(COMMENTS:VARCHAR, 备注, Examples: [四川模拟测试数据；非真实测站或实测水情]),
(MODITIME:DATETIME, 最新修改时间, Examples: [2025-06-01 00:00:00]),
(RVCD:VARCHAR, 河流代码，补充自字段文档, Examples: [SCT001, SCT002, SCT003])
]
# Table: businessdb.ST_FORECAST_F, 水情预报成果
[
(STCD:CHAR, 测站编码, Primary Key, Examples: [SC000001, SC000002, SC000003]),
(UNITNAME:VARCHAR, 预报单位名称, Primary Key, Examples: [四川模拟预报单位]),
(PLCD:VARCHAR, 预报方案或发布标识，按业务约定填写, Primary Key, Examples: [SC_DEMO]),
(FYMDH:DATETIME, 依据时间, Primary Key, Examples: [2025-05-01 08:00:00]),
(IYMDH:DATETIME, 发布时间, Primary Key, Examples: [2025-05-01 08:30:00]),
(YMDH:DATETIME, 预报发生时间, Primary Key, Examples: [2025-05-01 12:00:00]),
(Z:DECIMAL, 预报水位，m, Examples: [300.829, 300.819, 300.777]),
(Q:DECIMAL, 预报流量，m3/s, Examples: [85.648, 85.245, 83.504])
]
# Table: businessdb.ST_RIVER_R, 河道水情
[
(STCD:CHAR, 测站编码, Primary Key, Examples: [SC000001, SC000002, SC000003]),
(TM:DATETIME, 水情发生时间, Primary Key, Examples: [2025-05-01 04:00:00]),
(Z:DECIMAL, 水位，m, Examples: [300.7, 300.752, 300.779]),
(Q:DECIMAL, 流量，m3/s, Examples: [80.0, 82.061, 83.153]),
(XSA:DECIMAL, 断面过水面积，m2, Examples: [100.0, 102.576, 103.941]),
(XSAVV:DECIMAL, 断面平均流速，m/s, Examples: [0.8, 0.801, 0.805]),
(XSMXV:DECIMAL, 断面最大流速，m/s, Examples: [1.04, 1.041, 1.046]),
(FLWCHRCD:CHAR, 水情特征：1干涸、2断流、3流向不定、4逆流、5起涨、6洪峰, Examples: [5, 6]),
(WPTN:CHAR, 水势代码, Examples: [6, 5, 4]),
(MSQMT:CHAR, 流量测法代码, Examples: [1]),
(MSAMT:CHAR, 面积测法代码, Examples: [1]),
(MSVMT:CHAR, 流速测法代码, Examples: [1])
]
# Table: businessdb.ST_RVFCCH_B, 河道站防洪指标
[
(STCD:CHAR, 测站编码, Primary Key, Examples: [SC000001, SC000002, SC000003]),
(LDKEL:DECIMAL, 左岸堤顶高程，m, Examples: [305.0, 310.0, 360.0]),
(RDKEL:DECIMAL, 右岸堤顶高程，m, Examples: [305.2, 310.2, 360.2]),
(WRZ:DECIMAL, 警戒水位，m, Examples: [302.0, 307.0, 357.0]),
(WRQ:DECIMAL, 警戒流量，m3/s, Examples: [160.0, 180.0, 210.0]),
(GRZ:DECIMAL, 保证水位，m, Examples: [304.0, 309.0, 359.0]),
(GRQ:DECIMAL, 保证流量，m3/s, Examples: [240.0, 270.0, 315.0]),
(FLPQ:DECIMAL, 平滩流量，m3/s, Examples: [144.0, 162.0, 189.0]),
(OBHTZ:DECIMAL, 实测最高水位，m, Examples: [304.5, 309.5, 359.5]),
(OBHTZTM:DATETIME, 实测最高水位发生时间, Examples: [2024-07-20 08:00:00]),
(IVHZ:DECIMAL, 调查最高水位，m, Examples: [305.0, 310.0, 360.0]),
(IVHZTM:DATETIME, 调查最高水位发生时间),
(OBMXQ:DECIMAL, 实测最大流量，m3/s),
(OBMXQTM:DATETIME, 实测最大流量发生时间),
(IVMXQ:DECIMAL, 调查最大流量，m3/s),
(IVMXQTM:DATETIME, 调查最大流量发生时间),
(HMXS:DECIMAL, 历史最大含沙量，kg/m3),
(HMXSTM:DATETIME, 历史最大含沙量发生时间),
(HMXAVV:DECIMAL, 历史最大断面平均流速，m/s),
(HMXAVVTM:DATETIME, 历史最大断面平均流速发生时间),
(HLZ:DECIMAL, 历史最低水位，m),
(HLZTM:DATETIME, 历史最低水位发生时间),
(HMNQ:DECIMAL, 历史最小流量，m3/s),
(HMNQTM:DATETIME, 历史最小流量发生时间),
(TAZ:DECIMAL, 多年平均水位，m),
(TAQ:DECIMAL, 多年平均流量，m3/s),
(LAZ:DECIMAL, 多年平均最低水位，m),
(LAQ:DECIMAL, 多年平均最小流量，m3/s),
(SFZ:DECIMAL, 安全泄量相应水位，m),
(SFQ:DECIMAL, 安全泄量，m3/s),
(MODITIME:DATETIME, 最新修改时间, Examples: [2025-06-01 00:00:00])
]
# Table: businessdb.ST_TABLE_D, 表结构字典
[
(TABID:VARCHAR, 表标识，即业务表名, Primary Key, Examples: [ST_ADDVCD_D, ST_FIELD_D, ST_FORECAST_F]),
(TABNO:VARCHAR, 表编号, Examples: [DEMO_0006, DEMO_0002, DEMO_0008]),
(TABCN:VARCHAR, 表中文名称, Examples: [行政区域代码, 字段结构字典, 水情预报成果]),
(TABEN:VARCHAR, 表英文名称, Examples: [ST_ADDVCD_D, ST_FIELD_D, ST_FORECAST_F]),
(EXCHFL:CHAR, 交换标志, Examples: [1]),
(MODITIME:DATETIME, 最新修改时间, Examples: [2025-06-01 00:00:00])
]
# Table: businessdb.ST_PPTN_R, 降水量
[
(STCD:CHAR, 测站编码, Primary Key, Examples: [SC000001, SC000002, SC000003]),
(TM:DATETIME, 降水量截止时间, Primary Key, Examples: [2025-05-01 04:00:00]),
(DRP:DECIMAL, 时段降水量，mm, Examples: [0.0, 0.616, 4.199]),
(INTV:DECIMAL, 时段长，HH.NN，NN 表示分钟而非十进制小时, Examples: [4.0, 24.0]),
(PDR:DECIMAL, 降水历时，HH.NN, Examples: [0.0, 2.3, 7.3]),
(DYP:DECIMAL, 日降水量，mm, Examples: [0.0, 1.848, 12.597]),
(WTH:CHAR, 天气：5雪、6雨夹雪、7雨、8阴、9晴, Examples: [9, 7]),
(GGMD:CHAR, 观测方式：0或空为自动，1为人工，补充自字段文档, Examples: [0])
]
# Table: businessdb.ST_FIELD_D, 字段结构字典
[
(TABID:VARCHAR, 所属表标识, Primary Key, Examples: [ST_ADDVCD_D, ST_FIELD_D, ST_FORECAST_F]),
(FLID:VARCHAR, 字段标识，即字段名, Primary Key, Examples: [ADDVCD, ADDVNM, COMMENTS]),
(FLSID:DECIMAL, 字段顺序号, Examples: [1.0, 2.0, 3.0]),
(FLCN:VARCHAR, 字段中文名称, Examples: [行政区划代码，保留前导零, 行政区划名称, 备注]),
(FLEN:VARCHAR, 字段英文名称, Examples: [ADDVCD, ADDVNM, COMMENTS]),
(FLTL:VARCHAR, 字段类型及长度描述, Examples: [CHAR(6) COLLATE "utf8mb4_unicode_ci"]),
(NLAT:CHAR, 空值属性标志, Examples: [N, Y]),
(UNNM:VARCHAR, 计量单位名称),
(FCHSC:VARCHAR, 字段取值范围描述, Examples: [模拟测试字典]),
(EUFL:CHAR, 交换使用标志, Examples: [1]),
(PKAT:CHAR, 主键属性或主键顺序标志, Examples: [1, 2, 4]),
(MODITIME:DATETIME, 最新修改时间, Examples: [2025-06-01 00:00:00])
]
# Table: businessdb.ST_ADDVCD_D, 行政区域代码
[
(ADDVCD:CHAR, 行政区划代码，保留前导零, Primary Key, Examples: [510000, 510100, 510300]),
(ADDVNM:VARCHAR, 行政区划名称, Examples: [四川省, 成都市, 自贡市]),
(COMMENTS:VARCHAR, 备注, Examples: [四川模拟测试数据；非真实测站或实测水情]),
(MODITIME:DATETIME, 最新修改时间, Examples: [2025-06-01 00:00:00])
]
【Foreign keys】
ST_HIWRCH_B.STCD=ST_STBPRP_B.STCD
ST_STBPRP_B.ADDVCD=ST_ADDVCD_D.ADDVCD
ST_FORECAST_F.STCD=ST_STBPRP_B.STCD
ST_RIVER_R.STCD=ST_STBPRP_B.STCD
ST_RVFCCH_B.STCD=ST_STBPRP_B.STCD
ST_PPTN_R.STCD=ST_STBPRP_B.STCD
ST_FIELD_D.TABID=ST_TABLE_D.TABID
